clue.text: Piece of architecture makes me follow the party

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone joins a political party just to get a building of their own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'party' tempts towards politics, but here it is just a social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: A dome is a rounded roof, a distinct structural feature of a building.

clue.text: Portray a game as means of communication between two sides

definitions.text: means of communication between two sides

parts.note: to draw someone is to portray them in a picture
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: Drawing a picture of a game turns out to be a way for two parties to talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawbridge is a lifting span across a castle moat, the crossing that connects the two banks.

clue.text: Florentines with endless road up, having healing properties

parts.note: the Medici were the ruling family of Florence

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the trimmed word is read from bottom to top
endless means the last letter of the road word is removed

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road

explanation.surface: Some people from Florence on an unfinished road turn out to have curative powers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Medici were the banking family who ruled Renaissance Florence; in a down clue 'up' means read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Something medicinal has curative value, as a drug or remedy does.

clue.text: The proprietor is the one who disembarks outside the place for cargo

indicators.note: outside means the first word is wrapped around the second

parts.note: a lander is one who lands, coming ashore from a ship
a ship's hold is where its cargo is stowed

explanation.surface: The owner is the passenger who steps off the ship round about the hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disembarks' suggests a passenger, but the setter simply wants a person who lands, split around the hold.
explanation.definitionFit: A landholder owns or occupies land, so is its proprietor.

clue.text: Unfavourable rhyming publicity

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity, an advertisement
verse is rhyming writing, poetry

explanation.surface: An advertising jingle in rhyme gets a poor reception.
explanation.definitionFit: Adverse conditions are hostile or harmful, working against you.

clue.text: Being an aimless person, colour up about a quarrel

indicators.note: about means the reversed word goes round the next piece
in a down clue, up means the colour word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: red is a colour
a rift is a breach or quarrel between people

explanation.surface: A purposeless wanderer gets flushed about an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being an' is a link; the reversed colour gives DER, which splits around the quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A drifter wanders from place to place or job to job without settling or a fixed goal.

clue.text: Generosity of one who is writer and sailor in a dictionary cape

indicators.note: in means the writer-and-sailor pair goes inside the dictionary

parts.note: the OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a pen is a writing instrument
a hand is a member of a ship's crew
ness is a headland or cape, as in Loch Ness's shores and many British place names

explanation.surface: A generous person is both an author and a seaman, listed in a reference book of headlands.
explanation.walkthrough: Ness, a headland, appears in British place names such as Orford Ness; 'hand' for a sailor is standard crossword fare.
explanation.definitionFit: Being open-handed means giving freely, so the quality is liberality.

clue.text: Gloomy although you get your little daughter back

parts.note: D is the standard abbreviation for daughter
the rear is the back of something

explanation.surface: Things are dismal, though at least your young girl has returned home.
explanation.definitionFit: Drear is a poetic form of dreary, meaning dull and dismal.

clue.text: Part of Scotland which makes the penniless refuse

indicators.note: penniless means the abbreviation for an old penny, D, is taken away

parts.note: dross is waste or rubbish

explanation.surface: A Scottish region is said to turn poor folk into rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: D stood for the old British penny (from Latin denarius); taking it from DROSS leaves the Highland county of Ross.
explanation.definitionFit: Ross is a historic area of the Scottish Highlands, as in Ross and Cromarty.

clue.text: Swindle the wealthy although they are essentially the same

parts.note: to con is to swindle
substantial people are well-off, wealthy

explanation.surface: Cheat the rich, since deep down they are all alike anyway.
explanation.definitionFit: Consubstantial is a theological term for being of one and the same substance or essence.

clue.text: Sound reproduction with Rhodesian policy at heart

annotationWithheld.why: 'Sound reproduction with Rhodesian policy at heart' gives UDI (Rhodesia's declaration of independence) at the heart but nothing in the clue as held supplies the outer A and O; no source found.
annotationWithheld.clue: Sound reproduction with Rhodesian policy at heart

clue.text: Loves ices to be given free but is unable to say so

indicators.note: letters given their freedom are let loose into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone adores ice creams so much that a free one leaves them speechless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be given free' signals an anagram of LOVES ICES.
explanation.definitionFit: Being voiceless means having no voice, so one cannot speak.

clue.text: Flatterers support those who refuse to take part

parts.note: to back is to support

parts.words: those who refuse to take part
parts.note: to scratch is to withdraw from a contest, so scratchers pull out

explanation.surface: Sycophants support the people who opt out.
explanation.walkthrough: To scratch, in racing and sport, is to withdraw an entry before the event.
explanation.definitionFit: Backscratchers trade favours and flattery, as in 'you scratch my back and I'll scratch yours'.

clue.text: Proselytism on behalf of the heathen lawyer

parts.note: pro means for, on behalf of
a pagan is a heathen
DA is a District Attorney, an American prosecuting lawyer

explanation.surface: A lawyer acting for an unbeliever tries to convert people.
explanation.definitionFit: Proselytism, spreading a creed, is close to propaganda, originally the Church's congregation for spreading the faith.

clue.text: Mean although possibly I belong

indicators.note: possibly means the letters might form another word once rearranged

explanation.surface: A lowly sort wonders whether they really fit in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' signals an anagram of I BELONG.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignoble means base or dishonourable, as a mean act is.

clue.text: Bitterness was in control of most of the palace people

parts.note: to have run something is to have been in charge of it

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a court is a monarch's household and attendants

explanation.surface: Resentment arose when someone ran nearly all the royal household.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is deep-seated resentment or ill will.

clue.text: Tradesman is no longer batting with tradesman

parts.note: in cricket a batter who is out has stopped batting
a fitter is a skilled tradesman who assembles parts

explanation.surface: A craftsman who has been dismissed at cricket teams up with another tradesman.
explanation.definitionFit: An outfitter is a shopkeeper selling clothes or equipment.

clue.text: Half obtains a language for glue

indicators.note: half means only the first two of the four letters are kept

parts.note: to get is to obtain
Latin is a language

explanation.surface: Picking up half a foreign tongue proves sticky.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelatin is a jelly-like substance from animal tissue, used as an adhesive.

clue.text: Blissful state of the front in revolutionary Iran

indicators.note: in means the front word sits inside the rearranged letters
revolutionary means the letters of the country are turned about into a new order

parts.note: the van is the front, short for vanguard

explanation.surface: A happy condition reigns at the front line in Iran after its revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' gives the rearrangement NIRA, split as NIR...A around the front; van is short for vanguard.
explanation.definitionFit: Nirvana is the Buddhist state of perfect peace and freedom from desire.

clue.text: Two things to do with a boot when there is something left in the glass

parts.words: Two things to do with a boot
parts.note: the heel is part of a boot

parts.words: Two things to do with a boot
parts.note: a tap is a metal plate on a boot's sole, or to tap is to strike with it

explanation.surface: A boot's parts come into play when someone leaves a drop in their drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A heeltap is the dregs remaining in a glass after drinking.

clue.text: Mix with water an evil character who holds a deserter

indicators.note: holds means the evil character goes around the deserter

parts.note: Mr Hyde is the evil side of Dr Jekyll
a rat is one who deserts, like rats leaving a sinking ship

explanation.surface: A villain shelters a runaway soldier, then waters something down.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Hyde is the evil alter ego in Stevenson's tale; 'who' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To hydrate is to combine with or add water.

clue.text: Activity of nobleman with candy reshaped in a circle

parts.note: a count is a European nobleman

indicators.note: in means the rearranged sweet goes inside the circle

parts.note: a ring is a circle

indicators.note: reshaped means the letters of the sweet are put into a different form

explanation.surface: A nobleman pulls a sweet into a new shape while sitting in a circle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reshaped' gives YDANC, the rearranged sweet, which sits inside the circle after the nobleman.
explanation.definitionFit: Country dancing is a traditional folk pastime, often done in rings or lines.

clue.text: Hunter goes on about foreign city

indicators.note: about means the first word goes round the city

parts.note: taken as written
Rio de Janeiro is a city in Brazil

explanation.surface: A hunter keeps talking about some city abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes' is a link; Rio is a typical crossword 'foreign city'.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is the giant huntsman of Greek myth, also a constellation.

clue.text: The Greek has to give a hiding after practice boxing

indicators.note: has to give means the beating word is surrendered, taken away

parts.note: a Spartan is a Greek from Sparta
a tan is a beating, as in tanning someone's hide

explanation.surface: A Greek warrior dishes out a thrashing after a training bout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has to give' removes TAN from SPARTAN.
explanation.definitionFit: To spar is to box for practice, or a training bout.

clue.text: Prudish piece of writing about one giving birth for the first time

definitions.text: giving birth for the first time
definitions.note: the answer is a noun, a woman in this condition

indicators.note: about means the pair goes around the numeral

parts.note: prim means prudish
a para is a paragraph
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A strait-laced paragraph on a new mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts I between PRIM and PARA. The answer is a noun, so the definition stands for the woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Primipara is the medical term for a woman bearing her first child.

clue.text: The evil one gets inside us at another's peril

indicators.note: inside means the letters sit within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: The devil gets in among us, at the risk of others.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan is the Devil, the embodiment of wickedness.

clue.text: The chief culprit would be a counterpart if he lost the main role

indicators.note: if he lost works backwards: drop the main role from the answer and the counterpart is left

parts.note: a ringer is a lookalike or double
the lead is the main part in a play

explanation.surface: The gang boss would be just an understudy if he lost his starring part.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: take the main role out of the answer and a ringer, a lookalike, is what remains.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringleader leads others in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Song of a headless woman

indicators.note: headless means the first letter is taken off

parts.note: Maria is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A tune about a woman who lost her head.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song in an opera.
